parsed.reason: The message states facts ("Sunnyside Splash Pad is on Friday," "it's only $14 per child," etc.) with no attribution showing that Hale looked them up. There is no first-person verb of finding or checking ("I found," "I checked," "I looked up") anywhere in the message. The facts arrive flat and indistinguishable from information a stranger could have sent. Additionally, the message includes invented specifics (specific times like "9:15 sharp," "8:00," "6:30," specific facility names, specific program details for Etobicoke) that were not provided to Hale. The message reads as product introduction and hype ("Great news!", "There is honestly so much going on around you this week", "Want me to keep an eye on all of this for you?") rather than as a person reporting back on work they already did. The attribution is entirely absent.
